verdict.summary: Round 1's load-bearing test gap is fixed. WINDOW_VECTORS now includes allow rows at both exact inclusive endpoints and an allow row for Alice's unwindowed grant after the window closes, while retaining the no-clock case. The structural tests explicitly require both endpoint clocks and their allow expectations, and require Alice's inside/after/none clock set, so those cases cannot silently disappear or change expectation. The all-pass test exercises the real built store and the existing mutation witness preserves non-vacuity. The optional dependency remains behind the default-off odrl-bridge feature, and the expanded session grouping correctly keys all four session fields. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in the diff.
